name: Daimon Grubb (Ferengi trader, non-canon)

design.ref_text: Greetings, my good friends! Have I got a deal for you. Only the finest merchandise, at a very reasonable price. Trust me, I would never cheat a customer. Well, almost never.
design.picked_from: 6 candidates (fe1-fe6); highest male pitch and highest 1-3 kHz energy share (0.307, the nasal proxy)

notes: Wheedling, sly, salesman-bright. Performed pitch runs 145-170 Hz, above Riker/Picard and around Barclay but with a brighter, pushier delivery. Full sentences only.
